tool_schemas.name: search_pubmed_key_words
tool_schemas.description: Runs a PubMed keyword query using the provided key_words, stores the search request and resulting hit list, and returns up to num_results matching records (limited to the first page; no cursor-based pagination is supported). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if key_words is empty/blank or num_results is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED when search quotas for the caller are exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when PubMed is unavailable or returns an invalid response.

tool_schemas.name: search_pubmed_advanced
tool_schemas.description: Builds and executes an advanced PubMed query from the provided fields (term/title/author/journal and optional start_date/end_date filters), stores the request and hit list, and returns up to num_results results from the first page (no pagination token is issued). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if all query fields are null/blank, if start_date/end_date are not parseable dates, or if start_date is after end_date, and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds search quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when PubMed cannot be reached or returns an error payload.

tool_schemas.name: get_pubmed_article_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns normalized cached PubMed metadata for the given PMID, fetching and caching it from PubMed if it is not already present, keyed by the canonical PMID. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pmid is not a valid PMID value, NOT_FOUND when the PMID does not exist in PubMed, and RATE_LIMITED if the caller exceeds metadata fetch quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when PubMed is unavailable or the fetch fails.

tool_schemas.name: download_pubmed_pdf
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to locate and download a PDF for the given PMID (typically via PMC and/or publisher links), records the download attempt and outcome for auditing and rate limiting, and returns the fetch result (including failure status when no PDF is available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pmid is invalid, NOT_FOUND when the PMID does not exist in PubMed, and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds download quotas. Raises CONFLICT if a download is refused due to an existing in-progress attempt for the same PMID, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when external sources are unreachable or respond with an error.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_api_client
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity (api_client) along with its effective scopes/entitlements and current day quota usage. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the provided API key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is deleted.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored PubMed search request records for the authenticated client, newest-first, with optional filtering by tool_name and status. Returns a paginated page of search_requests. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication.

status.description: Filter by search request lifecycle status.

created_after.description: Return only requests created at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Return only requests created before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response to continue pagination.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored search_request by id for the authenticated client, including persisted PubMed execution fields and error details when present. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not owned by the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication.

search_request_id.description: Primary key of the search_requests record.

include_results.description: When true, includes the persisted hit list (search_results) for this request.

results_limit.description: Maximum number of search_results rows to include when include_results is true.

tool_schemas.name: list_pdf_downloads
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded PDF download attempts for the authenticated client, newest-first, with optional filtering by PMID and status. Returns a paginated page of pdf_downloads. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication.

pmid.description: Filter by PMID (will be normalized to digits-only).

created_after.description: Return only downloads created at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Return only downloads created before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response to continue pagination.

tool_schemas.name: set_article_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates the cached article lifecycle status for a given PMID in order to drive supported state transitions (e.g., mark stale to force refresh behavior, or restore to available after remediation). Returns the updated articles record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, NOT_FOUND when the PMID is not cached, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication.

pmid.description: PMID to update (will be normalized to digits-only).

status.description: New lifecycle status to apply; must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def set_article_status(api_key, pmid, status, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0439000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0439000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"
    today = now_dt.date().isoformat()

    def _append_log(client_id, credential_used, status_code, error_obj=None):
        # Observable dynamics: log every call
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        req_id = f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}_{os.urandom(3).hex()}"
        logs.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "endpoint": "set_article_status",
            "client_id": client_id,
            "credential": credential_used,
            "status": status_code,
            "error": error_obj,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # -------- Input validation --------
    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key must be a non-empty string")
        _append_log(None, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    if not isinstance(status, str) or status not in {"available", "stale", "fetch_failed", "deleted"}:
        err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "status must be one of: available, stale, fetch_failed, deleted")
        _append_log(None, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    if pmid is None or isinstance(pmid, bool) or not isinstance(pmid, (str, int)):
        err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pmid must be a string or integer")
        _append_log(None, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    if isinstance(pmid, int):
        pmid_norm = str(pmid)
    else:
        pmid_norm = re.sub(r"\D+", "", pmid)
    if not pmid_norm or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", pmid_norm):
        err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pmid must normalize to a digits-only string", pmid=pmid)
        _append_log(None, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    # -------- Authentication & client status --------
    clients = _load("api_clients.json")
    if not isinstance(clients, list):
        clients = []

    # IMPORTANT: per contract, authenticate by matching client-visible value or id.
    # The store contains api_key_hash; callers pass values like "sha256$..." which are stored directly.
    client = None
    for c in clients:
        if not isinstance(c, dict):
            continue
        if c.get("id") == api_key or c.get("api_key_hash") == api_key:
            client = c
            break

    if not client:
        err = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key")
        _append_log(None, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    client_id = client.get("id")
    if client.get("status") != "active":
        # Business rule: reject all tools for non-active clients; no mutations should occur.
        err = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Client is not active", client_id=client_id, client_status=client.get("status"))
        _append_log(client_id, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    # -------- Locate article by PMID --------
    articles = _load("articles.json")
    if not isinstance(articles, list):
        articles = []

    idx = None
    article = None
    for i, a in enumerate(articles):
        if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("pmid") == pmid_norm:
            idx = i
            article = a
            break

    if article is None:
        err = _err(
            "NOT_FOUND",
            "PMID not found in cache (business rule: set_article_status requires an existing cached articles row)",
            pmid=pmid_norm
        )
        _append_log(client_id, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    # -------- Enforce lifecycle transitions --------
    transitions = {
        "available": {"stale", "deleted"},
        "stale": {"available", "fetch_failed", "deleted"},
        "fetch_failed": {"available", "deleted"},
        "deleted": set()
    }
    current = article.get("status")
    if current not in transitions:
        err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Current article status is invalid in datastore", current_status=current, pmid=pmid_norm)
        _append_log(client_id, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    if status == current:
        # Idempotent: treat as success with no state change but still return the row.
        _append_log(client_id, api_key, "ok", None)
        return {"article": article, "idempotent": True}

    if status not in transitions[current]:
        err = _err(
            "INVALID_TRANSITION",
            f"Illegal status transition for articles.status: '{current}' -> '{status}'",
            pmid=pmid_norm,
            from_status=current,
            to_status=status,
            allowed=list(sorted(transitions[current]))
        )
        _append_log(client_id, api_key, "error", err["error"])
        return err

    # -------- Persist mutation --------
    updated = dict(article)
    updated["status"] = status
    updated["updated_at"] = now
    # Do not set last_fetched_at here; that's owned by get_pubmed_article_metadata success.
    articles[idx] = updated
    _save("articles.json", articles)

    _append_log(client_id, api_key, "ok", None)
    return {"article": updated}

tool_schemas.name: set_api_client_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the authenticated api_client lifecycle status (active/suspended/deleted). Intended for key self-rotation and emergency lockout workflows. Returns the updated api_clients record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is already deleted.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication.

status.description: New lifecycle status to apply; must be a valid transition from the current status.

metadata.name: PubMed MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores PubMed search requests, the resulting article hits, and a normalized cache of PubMed article metadata keyed by PMID. It also tracks PDF download attempts (often via PMC/Publisher links) and retains fetch outcomes, enabling rate limiting, auditing, and response caching for the MCP
